newsitem.title: UK: Algeria agrees cheaper Sahara for more lifters.
newsitem.headline: Algeria agrees cheaper Sahara for more lifters.

text.p: Lifters of Algerian Saharan Blend agreed a contract value at a premium of 39 to 40 cents to benchmark Dated Brent for July, traders said on Wednesday.
The level was agreed in talks in London with Algerian oil company Sonatrach.
Most lifters bid a premium in the low 30s, while Sonatrach offered around +45.
The first agreement, finalised around June 18, was at what the lifter called "just below" 40 cents for July.
The June price was 60/62 cents over Dated Brent.
